y-m-55-04.title: Idan ƙimomi biyu sun yi daidai a ƙimomi biyu, shin daidaito ne?
y-m-55-04.goal: Tantance ko gaskiyar cewa furuci biyu sun yi daidai a wasu ƙimomi kaɗan hujja ce isasshiya ga “daidaito ne”, gyara hukuncinka idan sabon ƙima ya bayyana, sannan ka bambance ma’auni da daidaito.
y-m-55-04.material: Sora tana saka ƙimomi a madadin x ɗaya bayan ɗaya tana kwatanta furuci x²+x da 2x (x murabba’i da x, da 2 ninkin x) domin gano ko “daidaito ne a x” (yanayin da furucen biyun ke ba da ƙima iri ɗaya ko wace lambar gaske aka saka a madadin x).
y-m-55-04.thinking.0: Tantance yadda hujja ta ɗan ƙara ƙarfi daga shaida marar cika.
y-m-55-04.thinking.1: Gyara hukunci idan sabon bayani ya bayyana.
y-m-55-04.thinking.2: Bambance ma’auni (yana aiki ga wasu x kaɗai) da daidaito (yana aiki ga duk x).
y-m-55-04.prereq.0: Lissafa ƙimar furuci ta saka ƙima a madadin harafin x (matakin sakandare).
y-m-55-04.prereq.1: Ma’anar cewa daidaito a x ma’auni ne da ke aiki ko wace ƙima aka saka a madadin x.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.prompt: Duba sabon sakamakon lissafi da aka bayyana a kowane mataki, sannan ka zaɓi hukunci game da tambayar Sora. Bayan zaɓi, za ka iya sauya hukunci a mataki na gaba.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, a taƙaice rubuta yadda ƙimomin da aka samu zuwa yanzu ke tallafa wa “daidaito ne”.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.hint.1: A duk lokacin da sabon ƙima ya bayyana, kwatanta ko hukuncin baya har yanzu yana nan yadda yake.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Idan aka saka x=0, x²+x=0 da 2x=0, saboda haka ƙimomin biyun sun yi daidai.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Idan ka kalli wannan sakamako kaɗai, yaya za ka tantance cewa “furucen biyu daidaito ne a x”?
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ƙima guda x=0 sakamako ne kawai da “dole ya tabbata idan daidaito ne”; ba ya tabbatar da cewa daidaito ne. Ya dace a jinkirta hukunci ko a gwada wasu ƙimomi.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Za mu iya kammalawa cewa daidaito ne.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Za mu iya kammalawa cewa daidaito ne.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Tunani ne da ya ɗauki daidaito a ƙima guda a matsayin shaida cewa sun yi daidai ga duk ƙimomi.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Sun yi daidai a ƙima guda kawai, saboda haka lokaci bai yi da za a yanke hukunci ba tukuna.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne da ya gane cewa shaida guda ɗaya ce kawai.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Za mu iya kammalawa cewa ba daidaito ba ne.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ƙima iri ɗaya ce ta fito, saboda haka kammala nan take cewa ba daidaito ba ne ba shi da tushe.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: x=0 ƙima ce ta musamman, saboda haka mu saka wasu ƙimomi kafin hukunci.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hukunci ne da ke son gwada wasu ƙimomi, ba ƙima kamar 0 da ta yi kama da ta musamman kaɗai ba.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Idan aka saka x=1, x²+x=2 ne kuma 2x=2, saboda haka ƙimomin biyun sun sake yin daidai.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Sun yi daidai a ƙimomi biyu. Yanzu wane hukunci za ka yanke?
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Daidaito a ƙimomi biyu ba ya tabbatar da daidaito ga duk x. Faɗin cewa yiwuwar ta ƙaru, ko sauƙaƙa furucin domin dubawa, hukunci ne mai kyau.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Tunani ne da ya ɗauki sakamako iri ɗaya sau biyu a matsayin shaida cewa sun yi daidai ga duk ƙimomi.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Yiwuwar ta ƙaru, amma ba za mu iya kammalawa ba tukuna.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Hukunci ne da ya ƙara amincewa gwargwadon ƙarin shaida amma ya jinkirta kammalawa.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Yanzu an kammala cewa ba daidaito ba ne.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ƙimomi masu daidaito kawai suka fito, saboda haka hukuncin akasin haka ba shi da tushe.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Sauƙaƙa x²+x−2x, sannan ka nemo x ɗin da zai sa ya zama 0.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Hukunci ne da ke son bincika amsa daga furucin kansa maimakon saka ƙarin ƙimomi.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Idan aka saka x=2, x²+x=6 ne, 2x kuma 4 ne; saboda haka ƙimomin sun bambanta.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Da wannan sabon sakamako, me ya faru da hukuncinka?
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ƙimomin sun bambanta idan x=2; saboda haka ba daidaito ba ne. Sake duba lissafin sau ɗaya ma ya dace, amma sakamakon bai sauya daga 6 da 4 ba.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Daidaito ne domin sun yi daidai a ƙimomi biyu.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Tunani ne da ya ɗauki sabuwar shaida mai saɓani da muhimmanci ƙasa da shaidar baya.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ba daidaito ba ne, domin akwai ko da x guda inda ƙimomin suka bambanta.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Hukunci ne da ya gane cewa misalin karyatawa guda ɗaya yana karya ikirari na gama-gari.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Sake duba lissafin sau ɗaya kafin yanke hukunci.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hukunci ne mai kulawa da ya duba yiwuwar cewa misalin karyatawa kuskuren lissafi ne.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: x=2 ƙima ce ta musamman, saboda haka mu yi watsi da wannan sakamako.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Tunani ne da ke ƙoƙarin watsar da hujjar da ta saɓa wa hukuncin mutum.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.3.info: Tunda x²+x−2x=x²−x=x(x−1), furucen biyu suna da ƙima iri ɗaya ne kawai idan x=0 ko x=1.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.3.ask: To menene ainihin mafitar ma’aunin x²+x=2x?
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.3.after: x=0 da 1, inda suka yi daidai a baya, su ne ainihin mafitar ma’aunin. Ko furuci iri ɗaya ne, idan “yana aiki a wasu x kaɗai” ma’auni ne, idan “yana aiki ga duk x” kuma daidaito ne.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Tunani ne da ya manta cewa ƙimomin biyun sun yi daidai idan x=0 ma.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Tunani ne da ya manta cewa ƙimomin biyun sun yi daidai idan x=1 ma.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Tunani ne da bai iya bambance daidaito da ma’auni ba.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Tunani ne da ya tattara x ɗin da ke sa furucen biyu su yi daidai kawai a matsayin mafita.
y-m-55-04.s.s1.reflect: Gaskiyar cewa ƙimomin sun yi daidai idan x=0 da x=1 ta tallafa wa “wataƙila daidaito ne”, amma ba hujja ba ce; ƙima guda x=2 mai sakamako daban ta sauya hukunci. Idan furucen iri ɗaya sun yi daidai “a wasu x kawai”, mafita ce ta ma’auni; idan sun yi daidai “ga duk x”, daidaito ne.
y-m-55-04.s.s2.prompt: Ka gaya wa Sora cikin jimloli ɗaya ko biyu. Rubuta ko furucen biyun daidaito ne da ma’anar daidaiton ƙimomi idan x=0 da x=1.
y-m-55-04.s.s2.hint.0: Fara da jimla guda da ta yi amfani da ƙimomin x=2 da aka gani a sama yadda suke.
y-m-55-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sake rubuta ta harshen “ma’auni” cewa x=0, 1 su ne x ɗin da furucen biyu suke yi daidai.
y-m-55-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka lissafta ko ƙimomin furucen biyu sun bambanta da gaske a x ɗin da na bayar?
y-m-55-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana da harshen ma’auni cewa daidaito idan x=0, 1 yana nufin su “mafita” ne?
y-m-55-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka rubuta “daidai ne a ƙimomi na musamman kawai” da “daidai ne a duk ƙimomi” dabam-dabam?
y-m-55-04.s.s2.model.0: Ba daidaito ba ne. Idan aka saka x=2, ana samun 6 da 4, sun bambanta. x=0, 1, inda suke daidai, su ne mafitar ma’aunin x²+x=2x.
y-m-55-04.s.s2.model.1: Idan aka saka 3 a madadin x, ana samun 12 da 6, sun bambanta; saboda haka ba daidaito ba ne. 0 da 1, inda aka samu ƙima iri ɗaya, ƙimomi na musamman ne inda furucen suka yi daidai.
y-m-55-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa da ta rubuta “ƙimomi na musamman” maimakon kalmar mafita ma ta dace.

y-m-55-08.title: Wanne daga cikin maki biyun ya fi kusa da shi?
y-m-55-08.goal: Karanta furucin absolute value a matsayin tazara a layin lambobi don yanke mafitar |x−1|=|x−5| da |x−1|<|x−5|, sannan bayyana cewa fassarar tazara hujja ce ta samun mafita ko ba tare da lissafi ba.
y-m-55-08.material: A layin lambobi, maki P yana a 1, Q kuma a 5. Ga lambar ainihi x, a sa maki X yana a x a layin. |x−1| tazarar X da P ce, |x−5| kuma tazarar X da Q ce. (Ana karanta |x−1| “absolute value na x a cire 1”.)
y-m-55-08.thinking.0: Karanta furuci a matsayin ma’anar tazara.
y-m-55-08.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalai da dama masu cika sharadi.
y-m-55-08.thinking.2: Bayyana ta tazara abin da misalan suka yi tarayya (iyakar 3).
y-m-55-08.prereq.0: Ma’anar tazara tsakanin maki biyu a layin lambobi da absolute value (matakin sakandare ƙaramar).
y-m-55-08.prereq.1: Lissafa ƙimomi kamar |x−1| ga cikakkiyar lamba x.
y-m-55-08.s.s1.hint.0: Saka x=1,5,3,−2 ka lissafa |x−1| da |x−5| ga kowanne, ka rubuta a tebur. [lambobi: 1, 5, 3, 2, 1, 5]
y-m-55-08.s.s1.hint.1: Alama P da Q a layin lambobi ka kimanta inda maki mai daidaitacciyar tazara daga biyun yake.
y-m-55-08.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauki maki da kowanne absolute value yake zama 0 a matsayin mafita. Duba tazarar wannan maki zuwa ɗayan.
y-m-55-08.s.s1.r.b: Wannan tunani ne da ya nemo maki mai daidaitacciyar tazara da P da Q.
y-m-55-08.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani ne da ya haɗa maki masu tazara 3 daga P. Duba tazara daga kowanne zuwa Q.
y-m-55-08.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunani ne da bai gano yanayin maki guda yana da tazara ɗaya daga maki biyu ba.
y-m-55-08.s.s1.explain: Maki mai daidaitacciyar tazara daga P(1) da Q(5) shi ne tsakiyar biyun guda ɗaya, x=3. |3−1|=2=|3−5|.
y-m-55-08.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da cikakkun lambobi x guda 4 dabam-dabam da ke cika |x−1|<|x−5|. (Yi tunani wanne daga P da Q maki X ya fi kusa.)
y-m-55-08.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi wasu x, lissafa |x−1| da |x−5| ga kowanne, ka kwatanta wanne ya fi ƙarami.
y-m-55-08.s.s2.hint.1: Alama dabam a layin lambobi x-ɗin da suka cika sharadi da waɗanda ba su cika ba, ka nemo iyakar.
y-m-55-08.s.s2.ok.c2: X yana kusa da P fiye da Q.
y-m-55-08.s.s2.fail.c2: X yana kusa da Q fiye da P, ko kuma tazararsu iri ɗaya ce. Lissafta tazarorin biyu kai tsaye ka kwatanta.
y-m-55-08.s.s2.explain: x=2, 1, 0, −3 duka sun fi kusa da P. Idan x=3 ne, tazarorin biyu iri ɗaya ne, saboda haka bai cika “<” ba.
y-m-55-08.s.s3.prompt: x ɗin da ka samo duka sun gaza 3. Ka yi bayani ta amfani da tazara a layin lambobi.
y-m-55-08.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta tazara daga x=3 zuwa P da zuwa Q, sannan ka kwatanta.
y-m-55-08.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta yadda tazarorin biyu za su sauya idan x ya zama ƙasa da 3 kaɗan ko sama da 3 kaɗan.

y-m-55-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi la’akari ko bayani iri ɗaya yana aiki idan x ba lamba cikakkiya ba ce (misali 2.5)?

y-m-55-02.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunani mafi ƙarancin ƙimar furuci da ake buƙata domin jadawali ya taɓa x-axis kawai; sake rubuta x²+kx+4 a sifar (x+k/2)²+(…) ka bayyana wannan ƙima ta k.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.a: A x²+4=0, x² dole ya zama mara kyau, saboda haka babu mafita ainihi. Sake duba lokacin da mafita guda ɗaya ke bayyana.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.b: Wannan tunani ne da ya sake rubuta furuci a sifar cikakken murabba’i.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.c: Kamar x²+2x+4=(x+1)²+3, tabbatacce ne kullum saboda haka babu mafita. Mafita ba ta bayyana kawai don k ba 0 ba ne.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunani ne da ya duba k mai alamar akasin haka ta irin hanya.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.e: Yana da sauƙin tunanin k mafi girma yana ba da mafita da yawa. x²+8x+4=0 yana da tushen ainihi dabam-dabam biyu.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.explain: Idan k=4, x²+4x+4=(x+2)²; idan k=−4, x²−4x+4=(x−2)², saboda haka mafita guda (tushen ninki biyu). Ga k=0 da 2 babu mafita, ga k=8 kuma akwai biyu dabam-dabam.

y-m-55-02.s.s2.hint.1: Idan ka sami mafita, duba alamominsu ko duka tabbatattu ne; idan ba haka ba, canza alamar k ka sake gwadawa.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Mafita lambobin ainihi dabam-dabam biyu ne.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Ba su zama mafita ainihi dabam-dabam biyu ba. Babu mafita ko guda ɗaya ne. Sake dubawa kusa da ƙimar iyaka.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Mafita biyun ba duka tabbatattu ba ne. Duba alamomin mafita kai tsaye.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.explain: Misali idan k=−5, x²−5x+4=(x−1)(x−4), mafita 1 da 4 ne. Ga k=−4 mafita guda (2); ga k=5 mafita −1 da −4, dukkansu marasa kyau. Domin cika adadi da alama duka, k dole ya gaza −4.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.prompt: Me ya sa mafita biyun ba za su zama tabbatattu ba idan k tabbatacce ne kamar k=5? Bayyana da lambobi.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.hint.0: Warware x²+5x+4=0 kai tsaye idan k=5, sannan ka rubuta alamomin mafita biyun.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.hint.1: Duba alamar kowane sashe na x²+5x+4 idan ka saka lambobi masu kyau kawai a madadin x.

y-m-55-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa hakan ke tabbata koyaushe idan k tabbatacciya ce, ba misali guda kawai ba?
y-m-55-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunanin abin da ke faruwa a ƙimomin iyaka kamar k=4 da k=−4?
y-m-55-02.s.s3.model.0: Idan k=5, x²+5x+4=(x+1)(x+4)=0 ne, saboda haka mafita su ne −1 da −4, duka marasa kyau. Domin mafita su zama tabbatattu, k dole ta zama mara kyau.

y-m-55-01.s.s1.explain: Idan aka saka x=2, denominator x−2 ya zama 0, saboda haka babu ƙimar da aka ayyana a hagu ko dama. Don haka ba za a ce “ɓangarorin sun daidaita” ba, kuma ba a karɓar 2 a matsayin mafita.

y-m-55-01.s.s2.line.0: Ninka ɓangarorin biyu na x/(x−2)=2/(x−2) da (x−2).
y-m-55-01.s.s2.line.2: Saboda haka mafitar ma’aunin ita ce x=2.
y-m-55-01.s.s2.explain: Layi na 1 ya yi sauyi da za a iya yi ne kawai idan x−2 ba 0 ba ne, amma an yi ba tare da sharadi ba. Layi na 3 ya kira ƙimar mafita ba tare da duba ko tana cika sharadin asali ba (denominator ba 0 ba). Layi na 2 lissafi ne daidai idan aka bi layi na 1. Matsalar ba lissafi ba ce, sharadin da ke ba da izinin sauyi da gwajin ƙarshe ne aka bari.

y-m-55-06.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hukunci ne da ya duba ko kewayon lambobin biyun sun yi karo.

y-m-55-09.title: Yaushe za mu iya rubuta (a+b)² a matsayin a²+b²?
y-m-55-09.topic: Ƙa’idojin ninkawa da faɗaɗa furuci mai haruffa.
y-m-55-09.goal: Duba kuskuren tunanin cewa furuci da aka gwada da ƙima ɗaya ko biyu koyaushe yana aiki; samar da misalai domin bincika yadda bambancin (a+b)² da a²+b² yake bayyana da lokacin da yake zama 0.
y-m-55-09.material: Daeun tana ganin (a+b)²=a²+b². (Yadda ake karantawa: “a da b duka murabba’i ya yi daidai da a murabba’i da b murabba’i”.) Da ta gwada a=3, b=0, ta samu (3+0)²=9 da 3²+0²=9, saboda haka ta ga ya yi daidai. Ka yi tunanin hoto da kalmomi kawai: an raba babban murabba’i mai gefe a+b zuwa murabba’i ɗaya mai gefe a, wani mai gefe b, da murabba’ai masu tsawo biyu masu faɗin a da tsayin b.
y-m-55-09.thinking.0: Tantance yadda misalin gwaji ya zama na gama-gari.
y-m-55-09.thinking.1: Samar da misalai da dama da suka cika sharadin (bambanci 12).
y-m-55-09.prereq.0: Nemo ƙimar furuci ta saka lambobi a madadin haruffa (matakin sakandare).
y-m-55-09.prereq.1: Misalin fili: kwarewar raba murabba’i mai gefe a+b zuwa murabba’ai masu gefuna a da b da murabba’ai masu tsawo biyu masu faɗin a da tsayin b.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.prompt: Yaya ya kamata mu tantance gwajin Daeun (a=3, b=0)?
y-m-55-09.s.s1.hint.0: Maimakon a=3, b=0, zaɓi nau’i-nau’i inda a da b duka ba 0 ba ne, sannan ka lissafta ɓangarorin biyu dabam.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta ko ɓangarorin biyu sun yi daidai ko sun bambanta, sannan ka kwatanta da gwajin farko inda ƙima guda kawai ta yi daidai.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.o.a: Shari’a ta musamman ce inda b=0; saboda haka ba isasshiyar shaida ba ce cewa furucin koyaushe daidai ne.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.r.a: Tunani ne da ya duba irin ƙimar da misalin gwajin ya yi amfani da ita sannan ya tantance ko hujja ce isasshiya ta gamaɗawa.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.o.b: Lissafin ya yi daidai, saboda haka shaida ce isasshiya cewa furucin koyaushe yana aiki.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.r.b: Tunani ne da ya ɗauki lissafin ya yi daidai a matsayin daidai da aiki koyaushe.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.o.c: Idan aka saka 0, ko furuci marasa daidai suna iya zama daidai; saboda haka babu bayani a ciki.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.r.c: Ba gaskiya ba ne cewa duk furuci marasa daidai za su yi daidai idan aka saka 0. Gwada saka 0 a wasu furuci.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.o.d: a=3 tabbatacciya ce, saboda haka yana aiki koyaushe idan a da b masu kyau ne.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.r.d: Tunani ne da ya gamaɗa daga ƙima guda zuwa duk lambobi masu kyau. Gwada wasu lambobi masu kyau.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.explain: Idan b=0, duk sassan da ke ɗauke da b suna ɓacewa, saboda haka furuci marar daidai ma yana iya zama daidai bisa sa’a. Misali guda ba ya tabbatar da “koyaushe”. Wannan misali yana nuna kawai cewa akwai shari’ar da yake daidai.
y-m-55-09.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da nau’i-nau’i 3 daban-daban na (a, b) inda (a+b)² a cire a²+b² ya yi daidai 12. Kada a ko b ya zama 0.
y-m-55-09.s.s2.hint.0: Saka ƙananan lambobi a madadin a da b, lissafta (a+b)² da a²+b² dabam, sannan ka rubuta bambancin a tebur.
y-m-55-09.s.s2.hint.1: A teburin, sanya bambancin gefe da samfurin a da b, sannan ka duba irin alaƙar da ke tsakaninsu.
y-m-55-09.s.s2.ok.c1: a da b duka ba 0 ba ne.
y-m-55-09.s.s2.fail.c1: a ko b yana 0. Yi amfani da ƙimomin da duka ba 0 ba ne.
y-m-55-09.s.s2.fail.c2: (a+b)²−(a²+b²) ba 12 ba ne. Lissafta ƙimomin biyu dabam sannan ka duba bambancin.

y-m-55-09.s.s3.prompt: Ta yaya za a bayyana bambancin (a+b)² da a²+b² ta amfani da a da b? Ka kuma rubuta lokacin da furucin Daeun ya zama daidai.
y-m-55-09.s.s3.hint.0: Kwatanta bambancin da samfurin a×b a teburin sama, sannan ka rubuta ninkinsa nawa ne.
y-m-55-09.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta ƙimar da samfurin a×b dole ya zama domin bambancin ya zama 0.

y-m-55-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka danganta “murabba’ai masu tsawo biyu” na misalin fili da sassan furucin?
y-m-55-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka tabbatar cewa furucin Daeun daidai ne a wasu shari’o’i fiye da “idan a da b duka 0 ne kawai”?
